a0cd591b.task:
Perform comprehensive black-box reconnaissance and attack surface mapping for https://malpoth.com and https://api.malpoth.com.

OBJECTIVES:
1. Subdomain enumeration (subfinder, asset_discovery skill)
2. Port scanning and service detection (naabu, nmap)
3. Technology fingerprinting (WAF detection, framework identification)
4. Web crawling and endpoint discovery (katana, gospider) on both domains
5. JavaScript analysis for hidden endpoints/API keys
6. Map all discovered endpoints, parameters, forms, and API routes

DELIVERABLES:
- Save consolidated endpoint list to /workspace/recon/endpoints.txt
- Save technology stack summary to /workspace/recon/tech_stack.txt
- Save sitemap/URL structure to /workspace/recon/sitemap.txt
- Create notes for any interesting findings (auth mechanisms, API patterns, etc.)

SCOPE: Only https://malpoth.com and https://api.malpoth.com. Do NOT test external assets.
Be thorough but bounded - focus on high-value attack surface discovery.

d18f6c43.task:
Test https://malpoth.com for open redirect and authentication vulnerabilities.

TARGETS:
1. Auth redirect parameter: /?auth=signin&redirect=%2Fcart - test for open redirect by manipulating the redirect param to external domains, double-encoding, protocol-relative URLs, etc.
2. Authentication flow analysis - check for auth bypass, session fixation, token leakage in URLs
3. Next.js-specific auth issues (middleware bypass, server-side auth checks)

TECH STACK: Next.js + React behind Cloudflare WAF
RECON FILES: /workspace/recon/endpoints.txt, /workspace/recon/tech_stack.txt

If you find a valid vulnerability, spawn a validation subagent to build a PoC. If validated, spawn a reporting agent to file the report.

SCOPE: Only https://malpoth.com and https://api.malpoth.com
